Curse of Recklessness.desc: Curses the target with recklessness, reducing the target's armor by 175 for 120 sec. Cursed enemies will not flee and will ignore Fear and Horror effects. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

Curse of Shadow.desc: Curses the target for 180 sec, reducing Shadow and Arcane resistances by 75 and increasing Shadow and Arcane damage taken by 10%. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

Curse of Weakness.desc: Physical damage caused by the target is reduced by 4 for 120 sec. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

Dash.desc: Increases movement speed by 50% for 15 sec. Does not break prowling.

Deadly Aspects.desc: While Aspect of the Hawk is active, Auto Shot has a 10% chance of increasing ranged attack speed by 30% for 12 sec. While Aspect of the Beast is active, all melee auto attacks have a 10% chance of increasing melee attack speed by 30% for 12 sec.

Death Wish.desc: When activated, increases your Physical damage done by 20% and makes you immune to Fear effects, but increases all damage you take by 5%. Lasts 30 sec.

Defensive Stance.desc: Assumes a defensive stance that generates rage when the warrior is hit, as well as reducing rage decay while the warrior is out of combat. Lasts 180 sec.

Defiance.desc: Increases all threat generated in Defensive stance by an additional 15% while a shield is equipped.

hunter.desc: Increases your Parry chance by 5%.

paladin.desc: Increases your Parry chance by 1%.

Demonic Aegis.desc: Increases the effectiveness of your Demon Skin and Demon Armor spells by 30%.

Demonic Brand.desc: Consuming a brand deals 1 Physical damage.

Demonic Energies.desc: You heal your pet for 15% of all spell damage you deal. When you gain Mana from Life Tap, your summoned demon gains 100% of the Mana you gain.

Demonic Knowledge.desc: Increases your spell damage and your Demon pet's spell damage by up to 100% of your level while you have a summoned Demon pet active.

Demonic Pact.desc: Your Demonic Sacrifice effect is no longer cancelled by summoning a different Demon pet. Resummoning the sacrificed pet will still cancel the effect.

The effect is canceled if any Demon is summoned. Imp: Increases your Shadow damage by 15%. Voidwalker: Restores 2% of your total Mana every 4 sec. Succubus/Incubus: Increases your Fire damage by 15%. Demoralizing Roar.desc: The druid roars, decreasing nearby enemies' melee attack power by 46. Lasts 30 sec.

Demoralizing Screech.desc: Blasts a single enemy for 8 damage and lowers the melee attack power of all enemies in melee range by 41 for 30 sec.

Demoralizing Shout.desc: Reduces the melee attack power of nearby enemies by 10 for 30 sec.

Destructive Reach.desc: Increases the range of your damaging spells by 20%.

Deterrence.desc: When activated, increases your Dodge and Parry chance by 25% for 10 sec.

Devastate.desc: Sunder Armor also deals 150% weapon damage, increased by 10% per application of Sunder Armor already on the target.

Devastation.desc: Increases the critical strike chance of your Destruction spells by 5%.

Devotion Aura.desc: Gives 55 additional armor to party members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

Devouring Contagion.desc: Reduces the mana cost of your Devouring Plague by 50%. Targets that die while Devouring Plague is active spreads it, jumping to a nearby enemy within 10 yds for the remaining duration.

Devouring Plague.desc: Afflicts the target with a disease that causes 128 Shadow damage over 24 sec. Damage caused by the Devouring Plague heals the caster.

Dire Bear Form.desc: Shapeshift into Dire Bear Form, increasing Attack Power by 120, Armor contribution from items by 360%, and Health by 600. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and allows the use of various bear abilities. The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

Dirty Deeds.desc: Reduces the Energy cost of your Cheap Shot and Garrote abilities by 20, and your Garrote ability no longer requires you to be behind your target.

Dirty Tricks.desc: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sap and Blind abilities by 50%.

Disarm.desc: Disarm the enemy's weapon for 10 sec.

Disengage.desc: Attempts to disengage from the target by reducing threat. Disables auto-attack.

Dismember.desc: Viciously bites enemy appendages for 12 damage and reduces the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec.

Distract.desc: Throws a distraction, attracting the attention of all nearby enemies and reducing their Stealth detection as if they were 1 level lower for 10 seconds. Does not break stealth.

Dive.desc: Increases movement speed by 40% for 15 sec.

Divine Aegis.desc: Your critical heals create a protective shield on the target, absorbing 15% of the amount healed. Lasts 12 sec.

Divine Favor.desc: When activated, gives your next Flash of Light, Holy Light, or Holy Shock spell a 100% critical effect chance.

Divine Fury.desc: Reduces the casting time of your Smite, Holy Fire, Heal, and Greater Heal spells by 0.5 sec.

Divine Grace.desc: Instantly heals a friendly target below 50% Health for 149 and removes Weakened Soul from that target. Cannot be cast on self.

Divine Intervention.desc: The paladin sacrifices himself to remove the targeted party member from harms way. Enemies will stop attacking the protected party member, who will be immune to all harmful attacks but cannot take any action for 180 sec.

Divine Precision.desc: Improves your chance to hit with Holy spells by 18%.

Divine Shield.desc: Protects the paladin from all damage and spells for 10 sec, but reduces all damage you deal by 50%. Applies Forbearance for 60 sec. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active.

Divine Spirit.desc: Holy power infuses the target, increasing their Spirit by 17 for 3600 sec.

Drain Life.desc: Transfers 10 health every 1 second from the target to the caster. Lasts 5 sec.

Drain Soul.desc: Drains the soul of the target, causing 85 Shadow damage over 15 sec. Non-trivial targets damaged by Drain Soul have a chance to grant you a Soul Shard. Non-trivial targets killed by Drain Soul will always grant you a Soul shard. Soul Shards are required for other spells.

rogue.desc: Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 50%.

warrior.desc: Increases your off-hand weapon damage by 5% and chance to hit with off-hand attacks by 10%.

Dual Wield Specialization.desc: Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 50%.

Dust Cloud.desc: Your tallstrider kicks up an abrasive cloud of dust, reducing the target's Armor by 65 for 30 sec.

EZ-Thro Dark Bomb.desc: Inflicts 450 Fire damage and stuns targets in a 5 yd radius for 4 sec. Any damage will break the effect.

EZ-Thro Mana Bomb.desc: Burns 900 mana from those in the blast radius and deals 50% of the mana drained in damage to the target. Also Silences targets in the blast for 5 sec.

Early Demise.desc: Increases Shadow Word: Death's critical strike chance on targets at or below 20% health by 30%.

Earth Shock.desc: Instantly shocks the target with concussive force, causing 18 Nature damage. It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 2 sec. Causes a high amount of threat.

Earth's Grasp.desc: Increases the health of your Stoneclaw Totem by 25% and the radius of your Earthbind Totem by 10%.
